title: Unmasking the Factual-Conceptual Gap in Persian Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces DIVANBENCH, which evaluates Persian Large Language Models on their understanding of cultural and spiritual concepts. This includes benchmarking knowledge of religious traditions such as Islamic practices (vow offerings, sacrifices, Bismillah invocations, and holy verses), ancient Zoroastrian beliefs, and folk cosmology featuring supernatural beings like jinn.
